query_ground_truth.query: query Salesforce to retrieve current leads and contacts
query_ground_truth.rationale: An agent needs to locate specific leads and contacts before managing their campaign memberships or updating statuses.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if field API names/relationships are unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Inspect lead fields using SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT (avoid invalid/unselectable fields in list or SOQL).
[Optional (if exporting very large volumes)] [Prerequisite]: Check remaining API headroom using SALESFORCE_GET_ORG_LIMITS (anticipate throttling before long pagination loops).
[Optional (if you need an exact total before export)] [Step]: Get lead record count using SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY (use COUNT() and capture total).
[Required] [Step]: Export lead rows using SALESFORCE_LIST_LEADS (request a minimal field set; apply any needed filters).
[Required (if response indicates more pages)] [Next Step]: Continue pagination using SALESFORCE_LIST_LEADS (follow the server-provided next-page reference; accumulate until complete).

[Fallback (if SALESFORCE_LIST_LEADS can’t express needed filtering/sort, payloads truncate, or results seem incomplete)] [Fallback]: Re-run using SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY with a minimal SELECT and conservative LIMIT; escalate to SALESFORCE_QUERY_ALL only when broader query context is required.
[Optional (if you need full details for one exported record)] [Next Step]: Retrieve a single lead using SALESFORCE_GET_LEAD (use the record identifier from the export).
known_pitfalls: [SALESFORCE_LIST_LEADS] Modifying the server-provided next-page reference can cause HTTP 404 or stalled pagination.
[SALESFORCE_LIST_LEADS] Records may omit/null fields or include nested relationship shapes; consumers must tolerate missing keys.
[SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT] Schema payloads can be extremely large and appear truncated in surfaced output; plan for offline parsing/search.
[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] COUNT() can fail with 400 MALFORMED_QUERY if written with unsupported aliasing; responses often use {done, records, totalSize} (records may be empty).
[SALESFORCE_QUERY_ALL] Can trigger REQUEST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED/HTTP 429; back off and honor Retry-After to avoid repeated throttling.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Iteratively merge paged lead records by following the returned next-page pointer until exhausted.
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
all_rows=[]
page=first
while True:
    all_rows.extend(page.get("items",[]))
    nxt=page.get("next")
    if not nxt: break
    page=fetch(nxt)
```

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Salesforce is a leading CRM platform integrating sales, service, marketing, and analytics to build customer relationships and drive business growth
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=salesforce. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="salesforce") to create a connection BEFORE executing any salesforce tools.

SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY.description: Executes a SOQL query against Salesforce data. Returns records matching the query with pagination support.

examples: SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact WHERE CreatedDate > 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z
SELECT Name, (SELECT LastName FROM Contacts) FROM Account
SELECT COUNT() FROM Lead WHERE Status = 'New'
SELECT COUNT(Id), StageName FROM Opportunity GROUP BY StageName
SELECT Id, Name FROM Opportunity ORDER BY Amount DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT Id, Name FROM Contact WHERE LastName = 'O\'Brien'
SELECT Id, Name, Description FROM Account LIMIT 10
query.description: SOQL query to execute. Must start with SELECT. Field names must match object schema exactly — use SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT for unfamiliar objects. ALIASES: No 'AS' keyword (use 'SUM(Amount) TotalSales' NOT 'SUM(Amount) AS TotalSales'). AGGREGATES: Without GROUP BY, ORDER BY/LIMIT not allowed (single-row result). COUNT() SYNTAX: Bare COUNT() only valid alone. With GROUP BY or other fields, must specify field: COUNT(Id) or COUNT(fieldName). Example: 'SELECT COUNT(Id), Status FROM Lead GROUP BY Status' NOT 'SELECT COUNT(), Status FROM Lead GROUP BY Status'. NON-GROUPABLE: Long text, rich text, encrypted text, compound address/location fields. NON-FILTERABLE: Long text area, rich text, encrypted text, multi-select picklists, blob fields CANNOT be in WHERE. FIELDS(ALL)/FIELDS(CUSTOM) require LIMIT ≤200. ID values need single quotes. Apostrophes use backslash: 'O\'Brien'.

SALESFORCE_LIST_LEADS.description: Lists leads from Salesforce using SOQL query, allowing flexible filtering, sorting, and field selection. Results are paginated; follow nextRecordsUrl in the response to retrieve subsequent pages — the first page may silently omit matching records beyond the page limit.

query.default: SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Company, Title, Email, Phone, Status, LeadSource, Rating, Industry FROM Lead
examples: SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Company FROM Lead WHERE Status = 'New'
SELECT Id, Name, Email, Company FROM Lead ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT Id, Name, Rating FROM Lead WHERE Rating = 'Hot' AND Industry = 'Technology'
query.description: SOQL query to fetch leads. Use standard SOQL syntax to filter, sort, and limit results. Field API names must be exact (e.g., LeadSource, LastModifiedDate) — invalid names cause MALFORMED_QUERY errors. Date literals like TODAY use the org timezone; use explicit ranges (e.g., LastModifiedDate >= TODAY AND LastModifiedDate < TOMORROW) to avoid boundary misses. Filter null Email with WHERE Email != null when downstream steps require it. Narrow LastModifiedDate ranges to avoid row-limit truncation.

SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT.description: Retrieves all fields (standard and custom) for a Salesforce object with complete metadata including field types, constraints, picklist values, and relationships.

object_name.description: API name of the Salesforce object to describe. Use standard object names (Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity) or custom object API names ending in __c.

SALESFORCE_GET_ORG_LIMITS.description: Tool to retrieve organization limits with max and remaining allocations. Use when you need to check ...

SALESFORCE_QUERY_ALL.description: Tool to execute SOQL queries including soft-deleted and archived records. Use when you need to query...

SALESFORCE_GET_LEAD.description: Retrieves a specific lead by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.
